---
title: >-
  Eunoia: Area-Proportional Euler and Venn Diagrams in Rust, Julia, Python, R,
  and JavaScript
description: >
  Eunoia fits area-proportional Euler diagrams and constructs Venn diagrams
  using a shared Rust implementation with Julia, Python, R, and JavaScript
  bindings.
author:
  - Johan Larsson
  - Nicole M. Lee
abstract: >
  Area-proportional diagrams show set sizes through the areas of their regions,
  but many combinations of intersections cannot be represented exactly by simple
  shapes. We present Eunoia, a Rust library that fits Euler diagrams and builds
  canonical Venn diagrams with four shape families: circles, ellipses, squares,
  and rectangles. It calculates region areas analytically, combines several
  initialization and optimization strategies, and reports diagnostics to assess
  the resulting fit. Plotting tools handle region polygons, labels, unit glyphs,
  and member names. Packages for Julia, Python, R, and JavaScript share the Rust
  implementation, as do a C interface and a web application that runs locally in
  the browser using WebAssembly.
date: 2026-11-01
